experiment: # Open this file ONLY when you need a per-mouse OVERRIDE of the experiment-wide defaults:
#   (a) experiment_list.csv has mouse_sex = mixed -- per-mouse SEX rows are then REQUIRED,
#   (b) different mice within one experiment have different strains/conditions,
#   (c) MULTI-ARENA experiments -- mice 1-4 ran on arena A and mice 5-8 on arena B,
#       so each cohort needs its own background_image (and possibly img_extent if the camera differs).
# Otherwise leave it as the bare header below; the experiment-wide values from
# experiment + mouse_id are the join key. sex: male/female. strain: free text (e.g. WT, ATRX-KO).
# background_image: filename in 2_background_images/, e.g. BKGDimage-20260101_arenaB.png. Leave blank to use the experiment-wide value.
# img_extent: same 4-number format as experiment_list.csv (left,right,bottom,top in cm). Leave blank to use the experiment-wide value.
# Per-mouse target coordinates: scope target rules to specific mice via the 'mice' column in targets/<DATE>_targets.csv.
